items.detail: Composite, all four legs evidenced. (1) No-warning commit: merge 75c094b (2026-11-20 22:52:22 -0500) is HEAD; post-merge guard logs .gitreins/logs/guard-20261121T035044.421600Z.log and T035229.151341Z.log (workdir /home/kara/get-h3/lore) show 'overall: PASS' and grep -i 'warn|unknown key|hook_timeout' across all 2026-11-21 logs returns nothing (rc=1); live GuardManager init on the fixed tree under installed gitreins 0.21.1 emitted EMPTY stderr. (2) Valid config + budget: validate_config_file('.gitreins/config.yaml') -> 'issue count: 0'; engine/config_schema.py:117-118 declares guards.test_timeout/hook_timeout as int keys while _EVALUATOR_KEYS (:145-161) has no test_timeout and the fixed evaluator block no longer carries it (removed by a556d76); config.yaml:24-25 sets test_timeout: 1200, hook_timeout: 1320, and live resolution gave test_timeout=1200, hook_timeout=1320, hook>test True. (3) Tier-1 PASS on fixed tree: prior-stage tier1 all-pass (lint rc=0, secrets clean, '572 passed in 9.37s'), guard log T035044 contains '572 passed', and fresh runs in this review: 'uv run pytest -x --tb=short -q' -> '572 passed in 5.07s' rc=0, 'uv run ruff check . --quiet' rc=0. (4) RED-proven on real commits: pre-fix probe 8faab64 (tree 9ec6fda, evaluator.test_timeout: 600, no guards timeout keys) is a real commit whose guard run printed 'WARN: evaluator.test_timeout: unknown key' (quoted in a556d76 message; worktree log /home/kara/worktrees/lore-INFRA-LORE-044/.gitreins/logs/guard-20261121T034124.365419Z.log exists); the warning mechanism itself was re-verified live (implicit 300<=1200 pair prints the exact WARN and derives 1320; explicit-equal pair prints the honoring WARN).
